name: a-fresh-instance-starts-from-nothing
note: The first half of ABI §5.1's re-instantiation pair. Nothing is seeded, so state_get answers ERR_NOT_FOUND and the block starts at zero — an absent key is an answer, not a failure (§7.2). What it leaves behind is what 09_state_round_trip is seeded with, and the block's own memory carries nothing between the two: a counter that kept its count in a field would pass this scenario and fail that one.
